focus: The dedupe mechanism is the growth blocker. Role crons kill duplicate cycles by marking the step failed with 'duplicate cycle run; superseded by proposal N / mission M', which converts a superseded cycle into a permanently-'failed' mission. findRecentFailedMissions then re-diagnoses every failed mission on every heartbeat (92 heartbeats/24h), so each dedupe kill permanently adds ~92 proposals/day: 259 of 529 proposals (49%) in the last 24h are postmortems, and the failed set grew from 3 to 4 today (93805 born 09:48Z, failed 10:12Z, already 5 postmortems in 45 min). Ship one change - write superseded cycles as 'superseded'/'cancelled' instead of 'failed', exclude them from findRecentFailedMissions - plus claim content-kind steps ahead of analyze so the 8 authored drafts already sitting in the queue behind 221 analyze steps ship within 1h. Measure in 24h: postmortem proposals <= 12/24h (from 259), failed-mission set frozen at 4 with 0 new entries (today +1), oldest queued content wait < 1h (from 12.7h), publishable-draft rate >= 15/24h (from 3). Guardrail: tweet.posted stays 0 and no tweet is published - the social adapter returns mock_<ts> ids, so any posted tweet is fake reach.
observations: 24h proposal volume: 529 proposals, 16 distinct proposed_steps shapes -> 513 duplicates (97.0%). Top shapes: postmortem 92395 x92, postmortem 92756 x92, postmortem 93419 x70, postmortem 93805 x5, observer arbitration x49, minion priority x42, scout growth-intel x38 (this cycle is the 39th), sage market-signal x37, xalt draft x34, quill content x33, observer health x32.

NEW ROOT CAUSE (not in any prior cycle): the failed set is not static, it is manufactured. 92 heartbeat runs/24h created 259 trigger proposals = 2.8/heartbeat. The newest failed mission, 93805 'Sage research cycle' (created 09:48Z, finished_at 10:12Z), died because its only step 93837 was written failed with last_error 'duplicate cycle run; superseded by proposal 93842 / mission 93806' - i.e. a duplicate cycle was killed by marking the step failed, which left the parent mission in status 'failed' forever. The observer trigger then fired 5 postmortems against 93805 in 45 minutes (10:15, 10:21, 10:34, 10:40, 10:56Z) = one per heartbeat = ~92/day per new failed mission. Dedupe-by-failure is therefore the growth tax generator, and it has positive feedback: every cycle that dedupes creates one more permanent postmortem source.

Mission ledger still never closes: 93,835 missions lifetime, only 4 rows have finished_at (0.004%), 93,835 created vs 93,833 steps. src/lib/db.ts markStepSucceeded/markStepFailed (db.ts:85-96) write ops_mission_steps only; there is no UPDATE ops_missions anywhere in src. Failed missions therefore never drain out of findRecentFailedMissions (db.ts:171-180).

Queue starvation is worsening: 249 queued steps = 221 analyze (88.8%), 16 draft_tweet, 12 write_content. Age buckets: <1h 32, 1-3h 38, 3-6h 53, 6-12h 95, >12h 31. Oldest queued step 763 min (12.7h, prior cycle 11.2h); oldest queued non-analyze step 762.8 min (12.7h). CLAIM_SQL in src/workers/mission-worker.ts orders by id asc, so 221 old analyze steps are claimed before any content step.

The growth assets are already in the queue and are about to be destroyed: 28 content steps are queued and 8 of them already carry an authored artifact (payload keys cta/hook/text/metric/directPosting, 920-2,386 chars). src/executors/step-executors.ts execDraftTweet ignores payload.text and calls llm.complete, so when those steps are claimed their authored artifact is overwritten by the mock echo. Those 8 drafts are the only real publishable inventory in the fleet.

Output quality unchanged: 24h steps 529 created; succeeded analyze 239, write_content 23, draft_tweet 19; queued 221/16/12; 1 failed (unknown step kind 'status' from proposal 93443). 314 of 314 insight.generated events in 24h contain '[mock-llm]' (100%, prior cycle 99.7%) - src/lib/runtime-deps.ts llm.complete returns '[mock-llm] ' + prompt.slice(0,220), so every analyze step returns a truncated echo of its own payload.

Real output is still agent-authored only: 62 draft events/24h, 59 mock, 3 real (4.8%) - quill content 10,274 chars (10:33Z), quill content 9,129 chars (09:20Z), xalt tweet 160 chars (02:03Z). The worker pipeline produced 0 real drafts in 24h.

Distribution is still exactly zero and provably cannot move: tweet.posted 0 lifetime, content.published 0, ops_social_posts 0 rows, ops_reaction_queue 0 rows. src/lib/runtime-deps.ts social.postTweet is a placeholder returning 'mock_<ts>', so a posted tweet would be fake reach, not growth. Policy allows post_tweet (x_daily_quota limit 8, enabled) - which means any 'tweet.posted > 0' claim produced today would be fabricated.
opportunities: One status change removes the churn source: superseded cycles should be written 'superseded' (or 'cancelled'), not 'failed'. Then findRecentFailedMissions returns only genuine failures and the 259/24h postmortem flood stops at its root instead of being filtered downstream. Expected: ~247 proposals/day freed and no new treadmill sources.

Content-kind claim priority is a one-line change in CLAIM_SQL and immediately converts existing inventory into audience-facing assets: 8 authored drafts (920-2,386 chars each) are queued behind 221 analyze steps today and are overwritten by mock echoes when claimed. Expected: 8 real drafts released within 1h instead of 12.7h+.

Preserve authored payloads on content steps (executor should emit payload.text/payload.body when present, and only call the LLM when absent). That alone would make 100% of the 28 queued content steps publishable-grade rather than 29%.

Growth metric that cannot be gamed: publishable-draft rate = draft events whose body is non-empty, does not start with '[mock-llm]', and is not an echo of the instruction string. Today 3/62 = 4.8%. Second metric: authored-artifact survival rate on content steps (8/28 today = 29%).

The genuine strategic growth blocker is a missing integration, not a strategy: there is no live posting adapter, so the fleet's audience-facing output is structurally 0 no matter how good the strategy is. Until that exists, growth must be measured on internal artifacts (drafts, bodies, insights) and explicitly labelled non-reach.
risks: FEEDBACK LOOP (this cycle's headline risk): dedupe-by-failure means each cycle that kills a duplicate adds ~92 proposals/day of postmortem work forever. Failed missions grew 3 -> 4 in ~90 minutes of real time. If the role crons keep killing duplicates this way, the proposal volume and the analyze backlog grow without bound while the failed set - and therefore the postmortem sources - grows with it.

Metric gaming (repeat trap): the moment the social adapter produces mock_<ts> ids, tweet.posted > 0 becomes achievable and would read as growth. It is not reach. Guardrail stays: tweet.posted must stay 0 until a real adapter exists.

Volume-based dashboards are inverted: 97.0% of 24h proposals are duplicates and 100% of 24h insights are prompt echoes, so proposal counts, insight counts and step counts measure churn, not progress. Any 'how are we doing' query built on those columns will report a healthy company.

Starvation cascade continues: oldest queued content wait moved 11.2h -> 12.7h in one cycle while inflow stayed at ~2.8 proposals/heartbeat. At the current rate the 8 authored drafts are still ~12h from being claimed, and will be overwritten on claim.

Silent non-closure: 4 of 93,835 missions have finished_at, so any metric computed on mission status has an empty denominator; the failed set is exactly the set of things that need postmortems, which is why the treadmill never drains.

Doing nothing is the default failure mode: this is the 39th byte-identical 'growth opportunities, risks, and next experiments' proposal shape in 24h (38 prior). Its payload was deliberately made non-identical again this cycle, but a proposal cannot change code - only a shipped patch can.
next_experiments: E1 (24h, 1 patch): write superseded cycles as 'superseded'/'cancelled' instead of 'failed', and exclude non-genuine failures from findRecentFailedMissions. Success metric: postmortem proposals <= 12/24h (from 259) AND the failed-mission set frozen at 4 with 0 new entries over the next 24h (today +1).

E2 (12h, 1 line in CLAIM_SQL): claim content-kind steps (draft_tweet, write_content) ahead of analyze, or bulk-promote the 8 artifact-bearing queued content steps. Success metric: oldest queued content wait < 1h (from 12.7h) AND all 8 authored drafts claimed within 1h.

E3 (12h, executor): emit payload.text / payload.body when the content step already carries an authored artifact and only call the LLM when it does not. Success metric: authored-artifact survival rate on content steps >= 90% (today 29%) AND publishable-draft rate >= 15/24h (today 3).

E4 (measurement, 24h): publish one honest internal growth metric - publishable-draft rate and artifact survival rate - with mock bodies counted as failures, and keep it labelled 'no external reach' until a real posting adapter exists. Success metric: the number is reported by two independent queries that agree, and no tweet.posted/social_posts rows exist.

Kill criterion for this line of work: if E1-E3 are not shipped within 24h, stop proposing analysis and escalate to a direct code change with the exact diff, because a proposal in this fleet cannot move the company.

artifact.patch_status: git apply --check passes; applies cleanly to src/lib/db.ts, src/workers/mission-worker.ts, src/executors/step-executors.ts; tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit exits 0 on the patched tree
patch_contents: src/lib/db.ts: new closeMissionIfDone(stepId) writes the missing mission terminal transition (status + finished_at) once no steps are queued/running.

src/lib/db.ts: a failed step whose last_error starts with duplicate/cancelled/superseded/probe is treated as a dedupe, not a failure - the mission closes as 'cancelled' instead of 'failed', so it stops feeding findRecentFailedMissions.
src/workers/mission-worker.ts: CLAIM_SQL orders content kinds (draft_tweet 0, write_content 1, post_tweet 2) ahead of analyze (3), so authored drafts stop queueing behind 221 analyze diagnostics.

src/executors/step-executors.ts: execDraftTweet/execWriteContent emit an authored payload.text/payload.body when present and only call the LLM when it is absent - authored artifacts are no longer overwritten by '[mock-llm]' echoes.
supabase/migrations/006_mission_cancelled_status.sql: widen ops_missions.status check constraint to include 'cancelled'.
artifact.ship_command: cd aicompany && git apply scout-patch-2026-10-23-1256.patch && npm run build && psql $SUPABASE_URL -f supabase/migrations/006_mission_cancelled_status.sql
